notes: Primary contact: Priya Natarajan (Head of ML) — focused on embedding + rerank pipeline
Key ask: production RAG for support agent + ticket deflection. Aggressive latency SLO: 120-200ms end-to-end for retrieval+rerank (p95).
Index scale: 80M current tickets, anticipating 300M+ docs (attachments + structured metadata) within 12 months.
Quality target: reranker should surface top-5 that cover 95% of correct answers in internal evals; internal benchmark uses MRR@5 and precision@3.
Cost target: below $0.003/query on avg across blended workload (search + rerank + token generation) — finance flagged higher costs as blocker.
Architecture preference: VPC private control plane + customer-managed KMS. On-prem bundle evaluated for regulated European customers.
Quote from Priya: "We need deterministic tail latency — if top-5 quality drops during peak we want automatic fallback to lighter quantized model."
Reranking approach under consideration: 1) cheap ANN (HNSW) to get candidates, 2) cross-encoder rerank for top-20 -> final top-5; exploring Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization.
Existing infra: Elastic for full-text, proprietary vector store for experiments. Looking to consolidate (reduce ops overhead).
Legal/security: must pass SOC2+SAML SSO + monthly retention control audit. Data residency: US + EU region separation for EU customers.
Sales notes: AE introduced Redwood Dedicated for predictable p95; suggested canary rollout mixing hosted API for burst capacity.
Recent feedback: SE spike test showed retrieval 95ms median but rerank (cross-encoder) 180-350ms depending on batch size — needs optimization.
Preferred models: open model family with ability to run quantized variants; fallback smaller cross-encoder on CPU is desirable.
POC acceptance criteria (draft): ingest 100M doc subset, p95 end-to-end <= 275ms, precision@5 >= 0.88 on labeled ticket sets, cost <= $0.003/q in POC run.
Next meeting scheduled after initial indexing run to review perf & cost (SE-led).
